messages:
customer_acct_admin: Hey, we're suddenly unable to access billing page or start new model runs for team 'acme-data'. Console shows 403 on /billing and models API returns "PermissionDenied". Can someone help?

Sara_support: Sorry about the trouble — I'm escalating to infra. Can you confirm account id and whether any IAM changes were made on your side?

customer_acct_admin: account: ACME-1872. No changes from our side. Billing works for other teams in the org.

sara_support: thx. @mike_sre can you take a look? I'll keep customer updated.

mike_sre: looking. Noting recent RBAC refactor rolled out ~2 hours ago (deploy 6f3a2b). Checking role mappings and the rolesync job.

olivia_sec: flagging for security review — this smells like a roles->attribute mapping change. @devon_eng do we have the deploy diff?

devon_eng: paste: ```
- org_roles_map: { "owner": ["org-admin"], "billing": ["billing-admin"] }
+ org_roles_map: { "owner": ["org-admin"], "billing": [] }  # bug introduced
```
Looks like billing mapping got cleared by mistake in the new mapping file.

mike_sre: I can see audit log entries: `audit: user=rolesync svc changed org_roles_map billing -> [] by deploybot@infra` — timestamps align. Also seeing 403s from model service: `authorization: role_required=billing-admin, found=[]`

sara_support: ok temporary fix — I've applied a scoped override: `redwood-admin assign-role --org ACME-1872 --role billing-admin --subject user:acct-admin` which restored billing and model run permissions for requester. Confirmed with customer.

customer_acct_admin: access restored — billing page loads and model runs start, thanks! :pray: 

olivia_sec: we'll need a postmortem and a rollback plan. Suggest adding CI check to prevent empty mappings and an alert on rolesync changes that remove all principals for a role.

devon_eng: agreed. I'll open PR to add schema validation and a production guard. Rolling back the mapping to previous mapping patch now (patch 6f3a2b->6f3a2b.1).

kms-bot: detect: KMS key policy unchanged. No KMS impact.

mike_sre: marking incident SEV3. Creating incident ticket INS-2026-114 and adding steps to reproduce and remediation.

sara_support: customer notified that account access restored and we have a ticket. Closing loop once PR merges. Thanks everyone.
